newsitem.title: UK: BFI up 10 as Panamax rates continue to rise.
newsitem.headline: BFI up 10 as Panamax rates continue to rise.

text.p: The Baltic Freight Index (BFI) was up 10 on Friday to 1,460 points with the panellists increasing route two (52,000 heavy grain USGulf to Japan) to 26.438 with combination.
But there were reports circulating that $26.25 with combo has been fixed for mid-March and also runours of $27.00 with combo for first half March.

A number of period fixtures of timecharters have been reported at between $11,000 and $11,750 daily for periods of up to 12 months but there were also reports that Far Eastern charterers have been declining Panamax period fixtures on subjects.
Caper and Handy-size rates have remained largely unchanged.
At 1300 GMT BIFFEX was hesitant with some profittaking expected to come into the market after the week's strength. Levels were 10points higher to two points lower and turnover totalled 101 lots.
